newsitem.title: EGYPT: Eipico to give 13 pound 1996 dividend.
newsitem.headline: Eipico to give 13 pound 1996 dividend.

text.p: Eipico/Egyptian International Pharmaceutical Industries will give a 13.00 pound dividend for 1996, lower than the 14.76 pounds it distributed in 1995, corporate figures made available on Thursday showed.
The firm decided the dividend per share at its annual general meeting which was held on Wednesday. Eipico has a total of 4.2 million shares.
Corporate figures showed that earnings per share in 1996 were slightly higher at 13.79 pounds from 13.77 pounds in the previous year.

The firm said its net after-tax profits rose in 1996 to 65.014 million pounds from 64.382 million in 1995. Total sales were 272.3 million pounds in 1996 up from 249.3 million pounds in the year before, it said.
Shareholders' equity was 169.2 million pounds in 1996 compared to 164.2 million.
